chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Najran, from 'Asim, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام:

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, the Imam from whom the hadith is narrated
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.عَنْ: from; a transmission link in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: the like of it; indicating the same meaning or wording as a preceding hadith

ai.seo_question: What does “مِثْلَهُ” mean in a hadith of Tahdhib al-Ahkam with a full chain of narrators?
ai.summary: This report cites a chain of transmission leading to Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, but the matn itself is abbreviated with the word “the like of it,” indicating that it repeats the previous hadith’s ruling or wording. In context, it serves as supporting transmission for the same legal judgment discussed in the chapter on shared participation in killing.
